name: channel_crossing_cylinders
comment: exp-002 case 6: 12x6x6 mm block (an X channel, open at the x=0 and x=12 faces) minus three through cylinders along Y and three along Z, R=0.8 mm; the axes intersect at (x,3,3) for x=3,6,9, forming '+'-shaped crossings. The cylinders are extended 1 mm past the block faces (extend_mm) to avoid boolean artefacts on coincident faces.
expected_area_note: The area for intersecting cylinders is not derived analytically (the side surfaces are cut by the intersection line) — only the volume is checked, the area is reported as measured from the STL.
